games.name: [GREAT SWAMPS UPDATE] Zone STALKER [Pre Alpha]
games.desc:
Enter the Zone.

Zone STALKER is a hardcore atmospheric extraction survival game inspired by the legendary STALKER series. Scavenge abandoned industrial ruins, survive deadly anomalies, hunt mutants, and fight hostile factions across a dangerous open world consumed by the Zone.

Every expedition is a risk. Build your loadout, manage your supplies, complete tasks, and extract with your loot before the Zone takes everything from you.

Travel alone or with up to 4 players in online co-op through dark forests, abandoned checkpoints, underground facilities, and radioactive wastelands where every gunshot echoes danger.

Features:
• Persistent character saving & progression
• Personal stash system
• Hardcore loot loss & extraction gameplay
• Dynamic anomalies, emissions, and atmospheric events
• AI factions, mutants, and random encounters
• Randomly generated Task.
• Detailed inventory & gear management system
• Squad-based co-op survival

(PRE-ALPHA) Expect bugs, wipes, and missing features!

games.name: Typical Colors 2
games.desc:
Dive into intense battles with over 200 unique weapons at your disposal!
Play as an offensive, defensive, or support role to push your team to victory.
This game is heavily inspired by Team Fortress 2.

Mobile Players: iOS devices are known to run much better than Android, if you have an android phone, make sure you have at least 6+ gb of Ram.

NOTICE: If you're noticing any frame drops, reduce your graphics quality and mess around with the game's settings [Main Menu > Settings (Top Right) > Graphics] (The game disables some visual features for better frames).

Basic Keyboard and Mouse Bindings:
M  -  Main Menu
W  -  Walk Forward
S  -  Walk Backward
A  -  Walk Left
D  -  Walk Right
Space  -  Jump
Ctrl  -  Crouch
Q  -  Previous Weapon
E  - Call for Doctor
Tab - Show Scoreboard
Numbers keys 1,2,3,4,5 - Select weapon
Scroll Wheel - Select weapons
Left Mouse Button  -  Primary Fire
Right Mouse Button -  Secondary Fire
Y or / - Open All chat
U - Open Team Chat

games.name: Arcane Odyssey 🌊
games.desc:
**This game has thousands of items and textures so 6 GB+ RAM is recommended**
**Keyboard + Mouse Required to Play**
** Dragon Update Patch Notes: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/ao/4615115 **

Embark on an epic journey through the War Seas, taking part in the conflicts of kingdoms and organizations striving for power. Many will die, but only the strong survive in this harsh, magic-polluted world. 

Conflicts are high as the many kingdoms wage war over possession of Curses, powerful artifacts which grant the user immortality and great power. After defeating great rulers and psychopaths for what you believe is the greater good, you leave yourself questioning what your true purpose in this world is.

Fight against other players, or team up with them and rule the seas as a clan, capturing islands, building castles, and becoming more infamous. Since you were born a mage, you have the option of mastering your magic, or dropping it entirely in favor of fighting styles, weapon mastery, and more.
